name: resume-editor
description: Develop rich, evidence-based, JD-tailored drafts for the Resume Editor HTML tool.

interface.longDescription: Resume Editor helps ChatGPT and Codex develop detailed resume evidence before tailoring and one-page prioritization. It combines evidence-integrity, JD-matching, writing, ATS/one-page, and role-specific guidance with schema validation, heuristic JD-signal extraction, claim review, and import-payload packaging.
defaultPrompt: Use $resume-editor to develop and tailor a rich resume for this JD without inventing facts.
Create a Resume Editor import JSON.
Review my resume claims and one-page risk.
